re_006.name: The rules are pure
re_006.text: model.js shall touch no DOM, no storage and no clock it was not handed, so the page, the CLI and the tests run the same rules.

re_001.name: Events are write-once
re_001.text: done, rework, purchase, energy, review, moment and visit shall never be edited; a correction is a new event.

re_002.name: Never rewrite a plan
re_002.text: Flow shall write into Planner’s workspace only flow.op records — addTask and timesheet.

re_004.name: Places stay on the device
re_004.text: Geofence coordinates shall never be in a record, a sync, a log or a repository.

re_005.name: Tests before code
re_005.text: Every change shall start with failing tests from SPEC.md; acceptance tests are written without reading the implementation.

re_003.name: No external origins
re_003.text: Storage keys shall be prefixed flow.; no fonts or CDNs from another origin; no app paths under /w/ or /assets/.
